name: honeycomb-hero
title: Honeycomb Hero
author: AlgorizeTech
description: A travel hero in deep teal: a light line over a huge gold word, and a honeycomb of hexagonal photographs with a gold hexagonal call to action set among them. The large hexagon is the slide on screen and its photograph tints the background; every five seconds, or on the arrows at the foot, every hexagon moves one step along the ring, endlessly.
docs: Named export: HoneycombHero. Pass `title` and `titleAccent`, `subtitle`, `primaryActionLabel` (a \n breaks the line) and `primaryActionHref`, `images` ({ src, alt }[] in queue order — nine cells are visible), `socialLinks`, `interval` in ms (0 turns autoplay off) and `onChange`. `accent` is the gold, `background` the teal; `linkComponent` takes next/link.
